content.text: Matt Fitzpatrick is a young Englishman on the rise. He is one of just two male players from the country to have won a major championship in the past decade, thanks to his US Open victory. Fitzpatrick had a successful amateur career, starting with a victory at the Boys Amateur Golf Championship. He made the cut at the 2013 Open Championship as an amateur, going on to win the Silver Medal. That was followed by a victory at the US Amateur Championship at Brookline, and he is one of just two Englishman to have ever lifted the trophy, after Harold Hilton’s victory in 1911. The Englishman dropped out of college after just a quarter to start his professional career, and he took his first DP World Tour victory in 2015. He won the British Masters at Woburn and has gone on to win the DP World Tour Championship, the season-ending Rolex Series event in Dubai, three times, including most recently in 2025. Fitzpatrick’s first win on American soil was also his first major win. He returned to Brookline nine years on from his US Amateur win and wrote a fairytale story. An incredible approach from a fairway bunker on the 72nd hole helped him to the US Open title. It was followed a year later by wins at the RBC Heritage and the Alfred Dunhill Links Championship. He has 13 worldwide professional wins to date. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) about Matt Fitzpatrick When and where was Matt Fitzpatrick born? Matt Fitzpatrick was born on September 1, 1994, in Sheffield, England. Fitzpatrick began playing golf at a young age, following in the footsteps of his older brother, Alex, who is also a professional golfer. When did Matt Fitzpatrick turn professional? Fitzpatrick turned professional in 2014, after a brief stint at Northwestern University. He qualified for the DP World Tour through Q-School at the end of that year. How many professional titles has Matt Fitzpatrick won? As of April 2026, Fitzpatrick has won 13 times during his professional career. Those victories include a major championship – the 2022 US Open – along with being a three-time winner of the DP World Tour Championship. His most recent win came at the RBC Heritage, as he won on Hilton Head Island for the second time. Who is Matt Fitzpatrick dating? Matt Fitzpatrick with girlfriend Katherine Gaal, holding the RBC Heritage trophy at Harbour Town Golf Links Fitzpatrick is in a relationship with Katherine Gaal, a finance and broadcast journalism graduate from Pennsylvania State University. She is a former Miss New Jersey runner-up, and is now a marketing manager, whilst also playing the odd round of golf with the Englishman. Did you Know? Youngest Ever Englishman to Win the U.S. Amateur Championship At just 18 years old, Fitzpatrick won the U.S. Amateur Championship in 2013. With his win in 2013, Fitzpatrick became only the second Englishman to win the U.S. Amateur, after Harold Hilton in 1911, and the youngest ever to do so. Nine years later, Fitzpatrick returned to Brookline and won the US Open. Family Golf Alex Fitzpatrick, like his younger brother Matt, is a professional golfer. The pair have both played in the Walker Cup, and thanks to Alex getting through Final Qualifying, both teed it up at The Open Championship at Royal Liverpool in 2023. Brothers Matt (left) and Alex Fitzpatrick (right) during the Zurich Classic of New Orleans in 2023, where the pair teamed up First Major, First PGA Tour win FItzpatrick won his first major title at the US Open at Brookline in 2022. The victory was also his first on the PGA Tour, after several wins on the DP World Tour, including two wins in the season-ending DP World Tour Championship. Data Analysis… To The Extreme Known for his scientific and analytical approach to the game, Fitzpatrick had logged every single shot he has hit since he was 15.
